key_insight: RS-MFBO speeds up expensive process optimization by combining sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization that prioritizes the most informative simulator calls.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to optimize complex industrial flowsheets with far fewer high-fidelity evaluations, lowering computational cost while preserving solution quality.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to reduce the search space to the most influential variables.
Fit a fidelity-aware Gaussian process that links cheap approximate simulations with expensive accurate ones.
Drive sampling with a cost-aware acquisition rule plus cooldown and promotion mechanisms to balance exploration across fidelities.
evidence_signal: The method was tested on two industrial simulators—plasmid DNA bioprocessing in SuperPro Designer and green fuel synthesis in Aspen HYSYS—showing fewer high-fidelity runs with competitive performance versus single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of sensitivity screening and on having meaningful low-fidelity approximations; weak correlations between fidelities could reduce the benefit.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
